name: Svelte Cubed — getting started demo (completed)
summary: StackBlitz project with the completed Svelte Cubed getting-started demo, a SvelteKit app rendering a Three.js scene.
description: A Node.js StackBlitz project based on svelte-cubed, three, @sveltejs/kit, @types/three, prettier, prettier-plugin-svelte and svelte. It is the finished version of the demo you build while following the Svelte Cubed getting-started tutorial.
